newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil airplane overshoots runway at Rio airport.
newsitem.headline: Brazil airplane overshoots runway at Rio airport.

text.p: A Boeing 737-300 plane owned by the Brazilian airline Varig overshot the runway on landing at the domestic Santos Dumont airport on Thursday, stopping just short of going into the sea, officials said.
The only one injured among the 132 passengers was a woman who sprained her ankle while coming down the emergency slide, a Varig spokesman said.
"There was an accident during the landing. We cannot say exactly what happened until we have investigated the incident," he said.
Eyewitness Evandro Mansur said he saw smoke after the plane touched down and heard what appeared to be two explosions.
But the Varig spokesman denied there had been any flames or explosions.

Local Globo television showed the airplane, which was on a regular shuttle run between Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo, apparently intact and at the very edge of the airport boundary, its nose up against rocks which separate the airport from the sea.
